text: dsh-kuajing 是一个连接 DSH 与 AI NetCafé 跨境业务工具服务的插件。它通过 cordis.patch.yml 注册一条 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 配置，使用 streamable HTTP 连接 ainetcafe.com 上的 MCP 端点。安装后，DSH 可通过该远程 MCP 服务接入其工具；本仓库只包含连接配置，没有工具逻辑实现。适合需要在 DSH 中接入跨境业务远程工具服务的用户。配置中没有 API 密钥或账号字段；调用服务需要通过网络连接到该端点。

dsh-kuajing connects DSH to AI NetCafe’s cross-border MCP service. It registers @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client with streamable HTTP and points it to ainetcafe.com. The repository provides the connection configuration; tools are hosted remotely. No API key or account is declared in the configuration.
想让 DSH 接入一个远程跨境业务 MCP 工具服务。
怎么通过 MCP 客户端把远程工具服务连到 DSH？
dsh-kuajing 的功能「连接远程 MCP 服务」：插件向 DSH 插入一条 MCP 客户端配置，使用 streamable HTTP 连接 AI NetCafé 的跨境业务端点。配置指向远程服务，仓库本身不包含工具实现。
dsh-kuajing 使用时会通过 MCP 客户端连接 ainetcafe.com 的远程端点，服务调用需经网络发送到该主机；本仓库的配置没有声明 API 密钥。（见 cordis.patch.yml:8-10）

dsh-kuajing README · dsh-kuajing：HS/HTS code lookup and classification, commercial invoices, live exchange rates, IBAN and EAN/UPC checks, amount-in-English for documents, and whether your site is actually reachable from inside mainland China.

dsh-kuajing README · What & why：`china_reachability` answers from a server that genuinely sits on a China Mobile backbone — latency, HTTP status and the IP China DNS resolves to. That is not inferable from an overseas VPS. On HS classification, be told the honest number: measured accuracy on our evaluation set is around 30%, below the 46.8% we were aiming for, so `classify_hs_code` returns candidates with confidence and the reasoning, and is a starting point for a broker — not a filing.

dsh-kuajing README · What & why：Every set ships `what_can_you_do` — describe a task in any language, get the exact tool plus a ready-to-run call.

dsh-kuajing README · What's in this pack：`—` in the price column means the tool is not metered per call (session/trial-gated instead). Failed calls are never charged. Check it yourself:

```sh
curl -s -X POST https://ainetcafe.com/mcp/kuajing -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'
```

dsh-kuajing README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:mario03690/dsh-kuajing
```

Thin config layer only (one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row, shipped as `cordis.patch.yml`) — no tool code runs on your machine. Built against the MCP client config shape of the dsh v0.1 developer preview; verified against the live endpoint on 2026-08-22.

dsh-kuajing README · Cost, quota, privacy：Mixed. Lookups and validators are $0.001–$0.004. `classify_hs_code` is $0.05 (model-backed), `make_invoice` $0.01, `china_reachability` $0.003 (a real network probe). Failed calls are not charged.

No signup for the free anonymous quota. Documents are processed in memory and not retained. The config URL carries `?s=dsh-kuajing` — a channel tag identifying the install path, not you.

dsh-kuajing README · Cost, quota, privacy：**Disclosure:** built and run by the team behind [ainetcafe.com](https://ainetcafe.com) — our own service, free tier plus paid usage. Full bundle (everything at once): [dsh-netcafe](https://github.com/mario03690/dsh-netcafe). MIT.

dsh-kuajing README · Compatibility & permissions (at a glance)：| Signal | This plugin |
| --- | --- |
| **Runtime** | dsh v0.1 developer preview (Cordis v4). Touches only the MCP client config shape — the narrowest surface available. Verified against a live endpoint on 2026-08-22. |
| **What runs locally** | Nothing. Ships one `cordis.patch.yml` row; there is no tool code, no build step and no lifecycle script in this package. |
| **Filesystem access** | None. |
| **Shell / process access** | None. |
| **Network access** | Outbound HTTPS to `ainetcafe.com` only, from the MCP client that dsh already ships. |
| **Credentials** | None required for the free tier. An optional AllRouter key, if you supply one, is sent by dsh as a request header and is never stored by us. |
| **Data retention** | Documents and prompts are processed in memory and not retained. |
| **Dependencies** | One peer dependency: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` (ships with dsh). |
| **License** | MIT (see `LICENSE`). |
| **Publisher** | The team that runs [ainetcafe.com](https://ainetcafe.com). Issues get a same-day reply. |
